title: Chechen/Ingush — Russian passport (ICAO/MVD), palochka dropped
authority: MVD Russia Order No. 996 (2019) / ICAO Doc 9303 for the Russian letters; palochka handling by fallback
description: Russian international-passport transliteration (ICAO Doc 9303 / MVD) for Chechen, Ingush and Dagestani names: Russian-form names romanize exactly as in ru_icao (Рамзан Кадыров → Ramzan Kadyrov), and the palochka Ӏ of native spellings and its look-alikes is dropped (ХӀасан, Хlасан → Khasan).
notes: Bearers hold Russian passports with Russian-form names (Рамзан, Ахмат, Хамзат, Магомед), which contain no palochka; the MVD table has no rule for it, so dropping it reproduces the Russian form in the common cases (ХӀасан → Хасан → KHASAN).

Palochka: U+04C0 and U+04CF are both accepted (U+04CF is folded to U+04C0 so that all-caps names stay all-caps); Cyrillic І/і is aliased to it. Latin look-alikes I, l, 1, |, Ⅰ and ǀ are treated as palochka only directly after г к п т х ц ч (the digraph positions); they are not aliased globally, so Latin text is untouched.
The native digraph къ is reduced to K (ъ dropped after к) instead of ICAO's KIE. Other native digraphs keep their letter-by-letter ICAO values (кх → KKH, хь → KH, аь → A).
The Ingush and Avar alphabets use the same palochka; this scheme serves them too.

rules.note: palochka look-alikes after г к п т х ц ч
